data.narrative:
NODA AI is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Philong Duong and Dave Corbett. The company has raised $29M to date and carries a current post-money valuation of $125M. The peer universe consists of 10 same-sector comparables at Series A or adjacent stages, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private peers include Stark Defence, Singularity, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods triangulate a coherent range. Stage-progression methodology applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $125M Series A post-money, implying $250M at the next financing stage. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set yields a $1.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $300M (minimum) to $4.0B (maximum). Stark Defence exemplifies the high end at $4.0B (Series A), while lower-stage peers cluster around $1.0B–$1.4B (Series B).

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $212M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $625M. Key uncertainties include NODA AI's relative revenue scale, customer concentration, and technology differentiation versus the peer set, particularly Stark Defence and Anduril Industries. The wide peer range ($300M–$4.0B) reflects material heterogeneity in this emerging sector.
